# Original study: https://github.com/thu-coai/Emotional-Support-Conversation

# note: In the Empathy paper, Seeker Relevance -variable is Response Relevance and Supporter Relevance is Disclosure Detail


```{r}
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```


```{r}
df <- read_csv(
  "~/Desktop/emotional_support_conversations.csv"
)

```


### DESCRIPTIVES ####

```{r}

# Check variable distributions

# Initial emotional intensity
ggplot(
  df %>% filter(!is.na(seeker_initial_emotion_intensity)),
  aes(x = factor(seeker_initial_emotion_intensity, levels = 1:5))
) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue", width = 0.75) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Initial emotional intensity",
    x = "Initial emotional intensity (1–5)",
    y = "Number of conversations"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)


# Final emotional intensity
ggplot(
  df %>% filter(!is.na(seeker_final_emotion_intensity)),
  aes(x = factor(seeker_final_emotion_intensity, levels = 1:5))
) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue", width = 0.75) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Final emotional intensity",
    x = "Final emotional intensity (1–5)",
    y = "Number of conversations"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)


# Perceived empathy
ggplot(
  df %>% filter(!is.na(seeker_empathy)),
  aes(x = factor(seeker_empathy, levels = 1:5))
) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#16B12C", width = 0.75) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Empathy Rating",
    y = "Number of Conversations"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)



```



```{r}
# Empathy rating percentages (i.e., how many gave 5/5 empathy rating, 4/5 rating, etc.)

empathy_table <- data.frame(
  Empathy_rating = 1:5,
  Number = as.integer(table(factor(df$seeker_empathy, levels = 1:5)))
)

empathy_table$Percentage <- round(
  empathy_table$Number / sum(empathy_table$Number) * 100,
  2
)

print(empathy_table)


# Empathy rating mean and sd

cat("Mean empathy:", round(mean(df$seeker_empathy, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
cat("SD:", round(sd(df$seeker_empathy, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
cat("Valid observations:", sum(!is.na(df$seeker_empathy)), "\n")
```

```{r}
df$emotion_improvement <-
  df$seeker_initial_emotion_intensity -
  df$seeker_final_emotion_intensity

# Emotional improvement
ggplot(
  df %>% filter(!is.na(emotion_improvement)),
  aes(x = factor(emotion_improvement, levels = -4:4))
) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue", width = 0.75) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Emotional improvement",
    x = "Change in emotional intensity (Initial - Final)",
    y = "Number of conversations"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)

# Emotional improvement: mean and SD

cat("Mean emotional improvement:",
    round(mean(df$emotion_improvement, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")

cat("SD:",
    round(sd(df$emotion_improvement, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")

cat("Valid observations:",
    sum(!is.na(df$emotion_improvement)), "\n")

```

### WILCOXON SIGNED RANK


```{r}

# Paired change in negative emotional intensity
change_test <- wilcox.test(
  df$seeker_initial_emotion_intensity,
  df$seeker_final_emotion_intensity,
  paired = TRUE,
  alternative = "two.sided",
  exact = FALSE
)

change_test

```



### CORRELATIONS ####


```{r}
# Correlation analysis: Initial emotional intensity and Empathy


cor.test(
  df$seeker_initial_emotion_intensity,
  df$seeker_empathy,
  method = "spearman",
  alternative = "two.sided",
  exact = FALSE
)

# Number of complete paired observations
n_complete <- sum(
  complete.cases(
    df$seeker_initial_emotion_intensity,
    df$seeker_empathy
  )
)

# Degrees of freedom
df_spearman <- n_complete - 2

cat("N =", n_complete, "\n")
cat("df =", df_spearman, "\n")

```

```{r}


# Create emotional improvement score
df$emotion_improvement <-
  df$seeker_initial_emotion_intensity -
  df$seeker_final_emotion_intensity

# Plot
ggplot(
  df %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(emotion_improvement),
      !is.na(seeker_empathy)
    ),
  aes(
    x = seeker_empathy,
    y = emotion_improvement
  )
) +
  
  # Jittered individual observations
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.25,
    height = 0.20,
    alpha = 0.035,
    size = 2.6,
    color = "#16B12C"
  ) +
  
  # Linear trend and 95% confidence interval
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    level = 0.95,
    linewidth = 0.9,
    color = "#16B12C",
    fill = "#16B12C",
    alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  
  # X-axis: perceived empathy
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:5,
    limits = c(0.75, 5.25),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
  ) +
  
  # Y-axis: emotional improvement
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 0:4,
    limits = c(-0.15, 4.15),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
  ) +
  
  # Axis labels
  labs(
    x = "Empathy",
    y = "Emotional Improvement"
  ) +
  
  # Clean journal-style theme
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 0.8
  )

```


# RELEVANCE-VARIABLES AND THEIR CORRELATIONS

```{r}


# Correlation: seeker relevance and perceived empathy

cor.test(
  df$seeker_relevance,
  df$seeker_empathy,
  method = "spearman",
  alternative = "two.sided",
  exact = FALSE
)

# Number of complete paired observations
n_complete <- sum(
  complete.cases(
    df$seeker_relevance,
    df$seeker_empathy
  )
)

# Degrees of freedom
df_spearman <- n_complete - 2

cat("N =", n_complete, "\n")
cat("df =", df_spearman, "\n")



```



```{r}
# Supporter relevance × empathy
test_supporter_relevance <- cor.test(
  df$supporter_relevance,
  df$seeker_empathy,
  method = "spearman",
  alternative = "two.sided",
  exact = FALSE
)

n_supporter_relevance <- sum(
  complete.cases(
    df$supporter_relevance,
    df$seeker_empathy
  )
)

cat("\nSupporter relevance × perceived empathy\n")
print(test_supporter_relevance)
cat("N =", n_supporter_relevance, "\n")
cat("df =", n_supporter_relevance - 2, "\n")
```
